question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **'habitat'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence*** ' Animal (4)___________ is also lost as a result of wildfires. '*** requires an appropriate word from the given options to fill in the blank number 4. • Let us explore the **given options**: • **Environment** means the conditions in which you live, work, etc. (रहने, काम करने आदि की परिस्थितियाँ; वातावरण) • **Habitat **the natural home of a plant or an animal. (किसी पौधे या पशु का प्राकृतिक आवास) • **Husbandry** means farming; looking after animals and food crops. (कृषि, खेती; पशुओं और फ़सलों की देखभाल) • **Domain **means an area of knowledge or activity. ((ज्ञान या कार्य का) क्षेत्र) • From the given meanings, we are clear that the blank number 4 requires** 'habitat**' word from the given options as per the context of the given sentence. • Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.** Correct Paragraph:__ *Deforestation, wildfires and pollution cause animals (1) __to__ lose their homes.
